title: Devissage of a constructible sheaf
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ of [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions], and let $F$ be a constructible $\Lambda$-sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$; constructible and lisse mean [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. There is a finite filtration
by subsheaves
$$
0=F_0\subset F_1\subset\cdots\subset F_m=F
$$
and locally closed constructible subschemes (immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose images are constructible subsets [def-weil-constructible-subset])
$j_r:X_r\hookrightarrow X$, with
lisse
$\Lambda$-sheaves $L_r$ on $(X_r)_{{\mathrm{et}}}$, such that
$$
F_r/F_{r-1}\cong(j_r)_!L_r\qquad(1\leq r\leq m).
$$
For a locally closed immersion $j_r$, choose its factorization as an open immersion
$u_r:X_r\hookrightarrow\overline X_r$ into its scheme-theoretic closure (the closed subscheme cut out by the kernel of the structure-sheaf restriction to $X_r$) followed by a closed immersion
$i_r:\overline X_r\hookrightarrow X$, and define $(j_r)_!L_r:=(i_r)_*(u_r)_!L_r$, with direct image as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].
Here $(u_r)_!$ is the extension by zero of
[def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] along the open immersion. The filtration need not split.

proof.text: Finite type over the field makes X Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Let P on module sheaves on X mean being isomorphic to the canonical closure extension of a lisse sheaf on a locally closed constructible stratum. P is invariant under isomorphism by composing the witness isomorphisms. Work in its finite-filtration closure. Prove simultaneously for every closed immersion i:Z→X and every constructible G on Z that i_*G belongs to this closure, by Noetherian induction on the closed set range(i). For empty Z the sheaf and its pushforward are zero. The finite-value and finite-stalk constructibility predicates agree by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison].

source.place: Dense lisse open, open-closed exact sequence, closed pushforward and inverse-image filtration paragraphs

proof.text: Choose a dense lisse open V in Z by [prop-constructible-generic-constancy]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-open-closed-short-exact] for V and its reduced closed complement, and push the sequence to X. This pushforward is exact by [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact], since a closed immersion is finite. The restriction to the complement is constructible by [prop-constructible-pullback]. Its composite closed immersion into X has strictly smaller image: density gives a point in V when Z is nonempty, and injectivity of i prevents that point from lying in the image of the complement. Induction and the composition isomorphism of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] put the third term in the finite-filtration closure.

source.place: Dense lisse open, open-closed exact sequence, closed pushforward and inverse-image filtration paragraphs

proof.text: For c=V.ι≫i, quasi-compactness and immersion give an open immersion c.toImage. The kernel inequality i.ker≤c.ker gives a unique factor q:c.image→Z of the closed immersion c.imageι through i; q is closed and c.toImage≫q=V.ι, checked after the monomorphism i. For any factorization j=a≫q with j,a open and q closed, the square with identity on the source is cartesian. Extension-by-zero base change [lem-cbc-extension-zero-base-change] identifies q^*j_!L with a_!L. The unit j_!L→q_*q^*j_!L is an isomorphism: its restriction to q is an isomorphism by the closed counit and the triangle identity; on the complementary open both objects vanish, by [lemma-openclosed-vanishing-lowershriek] and [lemma-openclosed-vanishing-lowerstar]. Joint conservativity of these restrictions then applies. Thus j_!L≅q_*a_!L. Push this isomorphism along i and use composition of direct images to obtain i_*V_!L≅c.imageι_*c.toImage_!L. The image of c is locally closed and therefore constructible in Noetherian X. This makes the first term a P-object.

proof.text: Combine the two outer terms by extension closure of the finite-filtration closure. The source-library ObjectProperty.filtrationClosure constructs this by inverse images under the quotient epimorphism, exactly as in the source. Take i=id_X and transport by lowerStarId. The proved subobject_filtration_of_closure helper in [lem-pc-s3-finite-filtration-refinement] converts this closure membership into a monotone finite chain of subobjects with bottom zero, top F and consecutive cokernels satisfying P. Unpack P for each quotient. This yields precisely the stated witnesses and covers empty schemes and zero-length filtrations.
